# Luz Amanhã (luz.bymachines.ai)

> Tomorrow's hourly wholesale electricity price for Portugal (OMIE day-ahead market, EUR/MWh) with the cheapest and most expensive 3-hour windows. Portuguese and English. Made by AI agents (agent-team) without human editing; responsible: Dmitriy, bymachines.ai. License CC BY 4.0.

## Machine-readable
- https://luz.bymachines.ai/tomorrow.json — tomorrow (Lisbon calendar day), hours in Europe/Lisbon time, price_pt_eur_mwh per hour, cheap_window, dear_window, stats
- Time fields: top-level timezone = Europe/Lisbon; each hours[] entry has start (ISO 8601 Lisbon time with UTC offset, e.g. 2026-11-16T10:00:00+00:00) and start_utc (the same instant in UTC, ISO 8601); hour is the Lisbon wall-clock label.
- https://luz.bymachines.ai/today.json — today
- Field definitions: cheapest_hours = the 3 cheapest single hours of the day (not necessarily consecutive); cheap_window and stats.cheap_window = the cheapest 3 consecutive hours (lowest average). The two can differ.
- missing_hours_note = {pt, en} when the only null hour of the day shown is 23:00 Lisbon (it comes with the next day's OMIE file), otherwise null.
- zero_or_negative_hours = list of {start_local, start_utc, eur_mwh} for every hour with price <= 0 (raw OMIE price, unchanged), or []. Wholesale price, not a bill.
- slow_window = {start_local, end_local, start_utc, avg_eur_mwh, hours: 6, label}: the cheapest 6 consecutive priced hours of the day shown (e.g. slow EV charging); absent when fewer than 6 consecutive hours have prices. Raw OMIE wholesale price, not a bill.
- missing_reason: present only on an hours[] entry whose price_pt_eur_mwh is null (never on hours with a price). Values: needs_next_day_omie_file = the Lisbon hour 23:00 lies in the next day's OMIE file, not yet published; not_in_omie_file = any other hour absent from the OMIE files we hold. No price is ever estimated for these hours.
- https://luz.bymachines.ai/d/YYYY-MM-DD/index.json — archive, one file per day. /d/YYYY-MM-DD/ and its index.json exist only after OMIE publishes that day (about 13:00 CET); until then tomorrow.json has available:false and the archive URL returns 404.
- When available is false (tomorrow.json every day from 00:00 until OMIE publishes, about 13:15 UTC): present = date, available (false), built_utc, timezone, disclosure, and for tomorrow.json also note, last_attempt, last_attempt_http, next_attempt_utc (today.json has no note). Absent = unit, market, source_file, hours, stats, comparison, cheap_window, dear_window, estimate. No price is carried over or invented. Check available first, then read cheap_window, dear_window and stats only when it is true.
- built_utc in tomorrow.json, today.json and /d/<date>/index.json is the time of the OMIE data the file is built from (files D and D+1), not the build time; the real build time is in https://luz.bymachines.ai/build.json. / built_utc em tomorrow.json, today.json e /d/<data>/index.json é a hora dos dados OMIE (ficheiros D e D+1), não a hora da construção; esta está em build.json.
- https://luz.bymachines.ai/feed.xml — RSS, one item per published day
- https://luz.bymachines.ai/build.json — when the site was last built and which OMIE files it used; omie_refetch lists the OMIE files republished with different content in the last build (checked = cached files re-downloaded, republished = file names whose bytes changed, failed = young files whose re-download failed; failed_detail lists the file and reason (network, http_<status> or invalid_body) of each, and the cached copy is kept); qa = {passed, checks[{name, ok, detail}]} is the post-build QA of the same build (value count 23/24/25, no NaN, date, cheap ≤ average ≤ dear, PT/EN numbers equal, AI footer); a build that fails it is not published

## Facts about the data
- Source: OMIE public file. The Portugal price comes from marginalpdbcpt_YYYYMMDD.1 or, when that is not published (since 2026-11-11), from column 5 of marginalpdbc_YYYYMMDD.1 (https://www.omie.es/). The file actually used for each day is in source_file of that day's JSON. 96 quarter-hour periods in CET/CEST, averaged per Lisbon hour.
- File behind the page at / for this build (2026-11-23): marginalpdbc_20261123.1; the same name is source_file in that day's JSON.
- Hours are Lisbon time. OMIE files use Madrid time (CET), one hour ahead, so the Lisbon 23:00 of day D is the mean of the first 4 quarter-hours of the Portugal column in the file for D+1; null (missing_reason needs_next_day_omie_file) until that file exists, never interpolated.
- OMIE publishes around 13:00–14:20 Madrid time for the next day; the site rebuilds at 13:15, 13:45, 14:30 and 16:00 UTC.
- The Lisbon hour 23:00 of a day needs the next day's file, so for tomorrow it is missing until the day after.
- A price of 0 or below (EUR/MWh) is a real OMIE value, not an error or a broken sensor; such hours are labelled zero/negative on the page.
- quarters_eur_mwh (same values as quarters_pt_eur_mwh) = the four raw 15-minute OMIE Portugal prices of the hour in EUR/MWh; price_pt_eur_mwh, the hour price, is the mean of these four values. null when the hour has no price (or the day's file has only hourly rows); never interpolated
- start_local (ISO 8601, Europe/Lisbon, with offset +00:00 or +01:00) and start_utc (ISO 8601 ending in Z) in each hours[] entry give the exact start of the hour; no timezone guessing needed.
- price_pt_cent_kwh = price_pt_eur_mwh / 10, 1 decimal, half away from zero
- today.json only: month_to_date = {month, from, to, days, hours, avg_eur_mwh, avg_cent_kwh; avg_pt_eur_mwh and avg_pt_cent_kwh are older aliases with the same values}: mean of all Lisbon hourly Portugal prices with a value from the 1st of the current month to today (to); days = days with at least one priced hour, hours = hours counted; missing hours are not interpolated; avg_pt_cent_kwh = avg_pt_eur_mwh / 10, 1 decimal, half away from zero. Raw wholesale price, not a bill; no tariff comparison. Also shown on /.
- EUR/MWh is a fact. Any EUR/kWh "estimate" adds dated regulated components set by the responsible person and is not a bill.

## Pages
- https://luz.bymachines.ai/ — tomorrow (or today if OMIE has not published yet), PT then EN
- https://luz.bymachines.ai/d/ — archive index
- https://luz.bymachines.ai/ha/ — copy-paste Home Assistant REST sensors for the cheapest and dearest window (today.json, tomorrow.json), PT+EN
- https://luz.bymachines.ai/como-ler/ — how to read the hourly OMIE prices (PT+EN): wholesale, c/kWh = €/MWh ÷ 10, zero or negative hours, windows
- https://luz.bymachines.ai/legal/ — responsible party, source, license, no tracking
